item: row 308: export destination manifests read hardened
summary: Before a build the export read the destination's previous volumes.json and building log with a plain read_text: a named pipe blocked the export, a link to /dev/zero read without end, deep nesting raised past the except, a non-object crashed it. Both reads (_load_reuse_pool, _previous_volume_size) go through R780's read_manifest_json with the volume format's own 256 MB ceiling (new max_bytes parameter); a reuse entry is kept only in the shape this module writes (plain volume file name, string digests, whole-number sizes) and a candidate is hashed only when lstat says it is a regular file, so a planted /dev/zero or FIFO name is re-written, never followed. A sound set is reused exactly as before (pool keys pinned to the written manifest). Plan R696, Opus read.
